finding: The existing runtime-v1 selector path already transports parsed material identity to the draw boundary, so Subsurface is not intrinsically constrained to global create-time shader substitution. A narrower material-aware draw-time PS carrier is structurally available and avoids requiring global shader-owner exclusivity.

chain.source: retail DSR parsed material selected from material container
chain.transport: selector_hook_entry preserves container/material_index and calls selector_event; selector_event resolves the exact parsed material and stores draw-local material identity as g_draw_donor
chain.consumer: on_draw_indexed consumes g_draw_donor exactly once and combines it with the currently bound exact receiver/pipeline host
chain.composition: existing unified draw transaction can bind a replacement pixel shader plus resource bridges and restore stock PS/CB/SRV state
chain.downstream: native DrawIndexed/DrawIndexedInstanced; failed qualification restores stock state and lets ReShade issue the original draw

narrowest_carrier: selector-authenticated material token + exact bound receiver -> draw-local PS substitution -> unified restore
evidence: runtime-v1/src/selector_hook.asm: material container and material_index are forwarded to selector_observer; retail selector layout is documented in-code
runtime-v1/src/mr_island.cpp: resolve_material reads [container+0x10] and 24-byte indexed material records; selector_event gates three certified selector return sites and stores g_draw_donor

runtime-v1/src/mr_island.cpp: on_draw_indexed consumes g_draw_donor, derives exact receiver_id from bound host, performs PSSetShader inside the unified transaction, then restores shader/CB/resource state
experimental/expanded-a3/audit/SELECTOR_CHAIN_HOTFIX2.json: shipping selector resolver executes before the observer at EXE RVA 0x22BA20

closed: material identity is available at selector time
material identity survives to the draw boundary in existing runtime architecture
exact receiver identity is available at draw time
draw-local pixel-shader substitution and fail-open restoration machinery already exist
open: Subsurface-specific DSR MTD identity authentication on this carrier
exact HemEnvSubsurf -> plain DifSpcBmp replacement selection on this carrier
proof that all three Ps_Body[DSBT] routes reach the certified selector return sites

governance.preferred_next_step: Implement a typed material-aware Subsurface readiness/carrier alternative that requires exact Ps_Body route authentication + exact receiver + certified replacement identity; retain the current create-time path as fail-open unless owner exclusivity is independently closed.
